module_description: Hierarchical Bayesian mixture model for Long-Period Radio Transient (LPT) classification, integrating multi-wavelength observables (radio, X-ray, optical) to identify accreting white dwarf binaries, pulsars, and unknown populations. Serves as the astrophysical validation counterpart to the cosmological Assembly Index halo classifier.

cross_domain_links.description: Fujitsu Kozuchi RAG modernization (97% time reduction) demonstrates how hierarchical Bayesian pruning of legacy codepaths mirrors mixture-model class pruning in LPT populations.
Halo classification via A_c and bootstrap significance maps directly to LPT class posterior probabilities. Both use hierarchical mixture models with missing-data imputation.

reference_source.name: ASKAP J1745
reference_source.significance: Rosetta stone for LPT population — first source with radio+X-ray+optical orbital phase-locking

pi.description: Mixture weights for K=3 physical classes

z_i.description: Latent class indicator for source i

mathematical_framework.inference_engine: Gibbs sampler with class-specific Normal-Inverse-Gamma priors

physical_classes.name: Accreting White Dwarf Binary
physical_classes.physical_mechanism: Roche lobe overflow onto magnetized white dwarf; radio from synchrotron in binary magnetosphere; X-ray from accretion shock; orbital modulation from aspect-dependent beaming
physical_classes.analogy_to_cosmology: Analogous to 'merging halo' class in TNG — both show strong multi-wavelength correlation and non-random phase coherence.

physical_classes.name: Isolated Ultra-Long-Period Pulsar
physical_classes.physical_mechanism: Rotational emission from magnetized neutron star; no accretion disk; X-ray from polar cap heating only; no orbital modulation
physical_classes.analogy_to_cosmology: Analogous to 'relaxed halo' class — quiescent, low entropy production, minimal environmental interaction.

physical_classes.name: Unknown / Unclassified
physical_classes.physical_mechanism: Placeholder for unmodeled physics or hybrid systems
physical_classes.analogy_to_cosmology: Analogous to 'anomalous high-A_c halo' class — requires further investigation, may indicate new physics.

bootstrap_significance.null_hypothesis: All LPTs belong to single class (no population structure)

integration_with_assembly_index.description: LPT classification provides a controlled astrophysical testbed for the Assembly Index formalism. The multi-wavelength correlation structure of ASKAP J1745 is a high-A_c signature in observable space.

formal_mapping.A_c_halo: Complexity of dark matter merger tree
formal_mapping.A_c_lpt: Complexity of multi-wavelength lightcurve correlation structure
formal_mapping.shared_property: Both measure deviation from random (Poisson/thermal) baseline via cross-domain pattern coherence

pipeline: Compute A_c for each LPT lightcurve (radio, X-ray, optical phase-aligned)
Compare A_c distribution across inferred Bayesian classes
Validate that WD Binary class has significantly higher A_c than Pulsar class (predicted: accretion geometry adds structural complexity)
Feed A_c as additional observable into Bayesian model (Level 2.5: complexity feature)

neuromorphic_extension.description: Lava-based SNN implementation for real-time LPT classification in radio survey pipelines

architecture.inference: Stochastic Gibbs sampling approximated by membrane potential dynamics with Poisson spiking

neuromorphic_extension.expected_speedup: 1000x vs CPU Gibbs sampler for streaming transient detection
